summary_en: Gerbera holdings extends tender offer for Metalart Corporation common shares from 2026-06-25 to 2026-07-13 (42 business days total). Tender price ¥7,600/share. Minimum acceptance 867,000 shares (30.29% of outstanding). Objective: complete subsidiary acquisition (完全子会社化). Extension provided to allow shareholders additional decision window and accommodate securities report filing and amended offer document requirements.
title_en: Notice Regarding Extension of Tender Offer Period for Common Shares of Metalart Corporation (Security Code: 5644) by Gerbera holdings Corporation
translation_en_brief: On 25 June 2026, Gerbera holdings Corporation announced an extension of its tender offer for Metalart Corporation (TSE Standard Market, code 5644) common shares. The offer, initially launched 15 May 2026 with a scheduled close of 25 June 2026 (30 business days), is now extended to 13 July 2026, for a total of 42 business days. The tender price remains ¥7,600 per share. The minimum acceptance threshold is 867,000 shares, representing 30.29% of shares outstanding. The stated objective is complete subsidiary acquisition (完全子会社化). The extension was determined after careful consideration of shareholder uptake and is intended to provide additional decision time to shareholders. The extension also accommodates the filing of Metalart's securities report (有価証券報告書) and the submission of an amended tender offer document, both procedurally required under the Financial Instruments and Exchange Act (Article 27-8(8)) and cabinet office ordinance (Article 22(3)). The target company's board has expressed support for the offer and recommended shareholder participation.
